brand.title: Follow the board. Build the stack.
brand.copy: A mobile-first weekly board that already blends morning gym work, calisthenics skill practice, speed and agility, and evening mobility so you can just follow the day and keep moving forward.

week.label: Mar 30 - Apr 5, 2026
week.focus: Midweek pivot: Monday run is logged done, Tuesday was missed, and Wednesday morning mobility was also missed, so the rest of this week stays recoverable instead of trying to force a perfect catch-up.
week.rhythm: Wednesday to Saturday: morning stretches at home, evening gym, Sunday full rest.

tracking.title: Log what you actually did.
tracking.copy: Use the shared session log after each morning or evening block. Sunday's update should read this log before building next week, and blank `Completed` cells are treated as not done, so mark completion, effort, joints, and any quick note while the session is still fresh.
fields: Notes: short context if something felt off
If `Completed` is blank, the automation treats it as not done

skillTracks.title: Push + balance
skillTracks.currentFocus: Build shoulder line, wrist tolerance, and overhead stacking before chasing freestanding handstands.
milestones: Scap push-ups and pike push-ups stay clean
Wall handstand hold 20-30s with ribs down
Box or elevated pike press strength improves week to week

skillTracks.title: Pull + lever strength
skillTracks.horizon: Chest-to-bar -> muscle-up / tuck lever -> front lever
skillTracks.currentFocus: Own scap depression, chest-to-bar intent, and hollow pulling before explosive skill attempts.
milestones: Pull-ups stay crisp without elbow irritation
Scap pull-ups and chest-to-bar intent become stronger
Tuck front lever or skin-the-cat prep can be added later without chaos

skillTracks.title: Core + compression
skillTracks.horizon: Hollow hold -> L-sit -> V-sit / press work
skillTracks.currentFocus: Train hollow body, compression, and hip flexor control so every other skill gets easier.
milestones: Hollow body hold stays solid for 20-30s
Hanging knee raise becomes strict and controlled
Compression work starts feeling like skill practice, not random ab work

skillTracks.title: Leg control
skillTracks.horizon: Split squat -> pistol progression -> clean pistol squat
skillTracks.currentFocus: Keep lower-body skill work honest with ankle mobility, single-leg control, and squat pattern quality.
milestones: Deep squat position gets more comfortable
Single-leg strength supports eventual pistol and jump control work

days.title: Run-only ramp-in
days.summary: Keep the first day easy. The point is to restart rhythm, not prove conditioning.

morning.label: Morning / no gym
morning.copy: No lifting today. Save your legs for an easy evening run.

skill.label: Skill block / none
skill.copy: No formal calisthenics skill work today. The skill win is showing up, keeping the run easy, and starting the week without digging a fatigue hole.

days.bodyweight: Skip the daily bodyweight block today.
days.note: If the run feels rough, turn it into a run-walk: 2 min easy run / 1 min walk.

evening.label: Evening / easy run
bullets: Calf stretch, couch stretch, hamstring stretch

swaps: Run -> incline walk if joints feel off
Run -> bike flush if legs feel heavy
Stretch only if your body still feels cooked

days.title: Lower strength + power
days.summary: First real gym day. Keep your bar speed clean and leave a rep or two in reserve.

skill.label: Skill block / pistol pattern
skill.copy: This is your lower-body skill slot. Keep it honest, balanced, and controlled instead of turning it into another leg burner.
bullets: Assisted pistol to box 3x4 per side

days.bodyweight: After the skill block, run the full daily target block: 1 set push-ups, 1 set dips, 2 sets pull-ups, and 1 set bodyweight squats.
days.note: Keep the squat set smooth. Stop the set when speed and shape start to fall apart.
swaps: Back/front squat -> hack squat, leg press, goblet squat
RDL -> DB RDL or 45-degree back extension
Walking lunge -> reverse lunge or step-up

days.title: Upper strength + control / evening gym
days.summary: The schedule flips here: morning is mobility, evening is gym. Since Tuesday and Wednesday morning were both missed, tonight stays lighter and cleaner than originally planned.

skill.label: Skill block / handstand line
skill.copy: Treat this as shoulder stacking practice, not circus work. Because the morning prep was missed, reduce the total volume slightly and make every rep look clean.

days.bodyweight: Use about 80-90% of the usual daily targets after the skill block tonight. If dips irritate your shoulders, switch to assisted or substitute.
days.note: Tuesday and Wednesday morning are now counted missed, so add a longer warm-up and stay 2 reps from failure on pressing.

evening.label: Evening / gym
bullets: 8-10 min shoulder and T-spine primer before lifting

swaps: Incline press -> DB bench or machine chest press
Chest-supported row -> cable row or 1-arm DB row

days.title: Lower strength + power / evening gym
days.summary: Tuesday's missed lower session moves here. Train hard enough to matter, but do not try to repay two days in one lift.

skill.label: Skill block / pistol pattern
skill.copy: This is the lower-body skill slot that got bumped from Tuesday. Keep it controlled instead of turning it into extra fatigue.
bullets: Assisted pistol to box 3x4 per side

days.bodyweight: After the skill block, run the full daily target block in the evening gym session.
days.note: No catch-up mentality. Wednesday morning was also missed, so Thursday morning mobility becomes non-negotiable before the evening lower session.
swaps: Back/front squat -> hack squat, leg press, goblet squat
RDL -> DB RDL or 45-degree back extension
Walking lunge -> reverse lunge or step-up

days.title: Athletic full body / evening gym
days.summary: Friday becomes the fast day. Move crisply, keep the intervals honest, and do not punish yourself for the missed Tuesday.

skill.label: Skill block / explosive pull
skill.copy: This is where you build pulling speed and intent without letting the quality get sloppy.

days.bodyweight: Run the normal daily block after the evening skill work, but cut the interval volume before cutting movement quality.
days.note: Keep the conditioning at 5 rounds if you still feel rusty.

evening.label: Evening / gym
bullets: Line hops or jump rope 5 min

swaps: Line hops -> pogo jumps or jump rope
KB swing -> med-ball slam or trap-bar jump
Bike/sled intervals -> rower sprint or shuttle runs

days.title: Posterior chain + integration / evening gym
days.summary: Last lift of the week. Touch power, touch skill, then stop cleanly so Sunday is real recovery.

skill.label: Skill block / weekly integration
skill.copy: Use a lighter mixed block here so every skill ladder gets touched once more before the rest day.
bullets: Hanging knee raise or tuck raise 2x8

days.bodyweight: Use the normal daily target block after the evening skill block. No heroics before rest day.
days.note: Blank rows count as missed, but do not try to erase the week in one session.

evening.label: Evening / gym
bullets: Front-foot elevated split squat 3x8 per leg

swaps: Acceleration drills -> incline treadmill sprint or sled sprint
Trap-bar deadlift -> conventional deadlift, rack pull, heavy RDL
Hip thrust -> glute bridge or cable pull-through

days.title: Full rest day
days.summary: No training. No catch-up session. Let the system reset so the next week starts clean.

morning.label: Morning / off
morning.copy: No gym. Walk if you want, but the day is for recovery.

skill.label: Skill block / off
skill.copy: Rest is part of the skill plan. You get better at the hard things by showing up fresh enough to practice them well next week.

days.bodyweight: Rest from the daily bodyweight work today.
days.note: A short easy walk is fine. Turning Sunday into a stealth training day is not.

evening.label: Evening / off
evening.copy: No formal mobility required. If you feel stiff, do 5-10 easy minutes only.
